thag18.1:1.1:
One shouldn’t go about
surrounded, revered
by a company:
thag18.1:1.3:
Fellowship with many people
is painful.
Seeing this,
thag18.1:1.4:
one shouldn’t approve
of a company.

thag18.1:4.1: Coming down from my dwelling place,
thag18.1:4.2: I entered the city for alms,
thag18.1:4.3:
stood courteously next to a leper
eating his meal.
thag18.1:5.2: tossed me a morsel of food,
thag18.1:5.3: and as the morsel was dropping,
thag18.1:5.4:
a finger fell off
right there.
thag18.1:6.2: I ate that morsel of food,
thag18.1:6.3:
and neither while eating it,
nor having eaten,
did I feel
any disgust.

thag18.1:30.2:
even though clad

thag18.1:30.4:

or vain,

shines
because of his robe of cast-off rags,
thag18.1:31.4:

thag18.1:37.4:
There’s no one else

thag18.1:38.1: The Teacher has been served by me;
thag18.1:39.6:

thag18.1:40.1:

the great sage,
has the establishings of mindfulness
as his neck,
thag18.1:40.2:
conviction
as hands,
